mackay_icosahedral_shells.notes: Mackay magic numbers computed using exact formula N_k = (10k^3 - 15k^2 + 11k - 3)/3

chiral_shell_categories.notes: Seven chiral categories (MC, BG, Ch1-Ch5) with shell sequences from data

size_mismatch_optimization.notes: Pairwise mismatch computed for all 42 element pairs with optimal ranges

lennard_jones_potentials.notes: Standard 12-6 LJ potential with parameters from data

path_based_growth.notes: Simplified path-based growth model using probability weights; full MD simulation not feasible in this environment

hexagonal_lattice_mapping.notes: Hexagonal coordinates and triangulation numbers computed

shap_permutation_importance.notes: Interpretability methods not required for this physics theory task; geometric analysis is self-interpreting

dft_first_principles.notes: First-principles DFT calculations require specialized quantum chemistry software not available; LJ potentials used as approximation

limitations: Lennard-Jones potentials are simplified; metallic bonding for transition metals may require embedded-atom or Gupta potentials
Growth simulations are coarse-grained path models, not full molecular dynamics
Experimental validation limited to 4 data points from the provided dataset
No DFT-level electronic structure calculations performed
fallbacks: LJ potentials used in place of DFT-calculated interaction energies
Path-based growth model used in place of full MD trajectory simulation
Geometric size mismatch used as primary stability predictor
